description: This file contains a unit test suite for testing the functionality of the CLIInstaller component, specifically the 'installedLocation' method, within the OpenClaw project. The tests verify whether the installer correctly locates the executable within specified directories.

classes.name: CLIInstallerTests
classes.description: A test suite for CLIInstaller, marked with annotations for testing framework integration, testing serialized execution, and main actor context.

methods.name: installed location finds executable
methods.description: A test method that creates a temporary directory structure, adds an executable file, and verifies that the CLIInstaller correctly finds or does not find the executable under different file permission scenarios.
